finding.metric_definition: the DHW planning price of a step where the space-heating profile draws more than the PV surplus (per-kWh), and the cheapest step's index
finding.phenomenon_property: On the co-optimization replan the surplus left for hot water is clipped at zero, so a step whose space demand exceeds its PV surplus is priced at the import price, never above it
